clips.title: The story
paras: Across Mulgore, Ambercorn falls beneath the ancient trees. Tauren gather it for the Water of the Seers, a brew used in the Rite of Vision.

Ambercorn falls beneath Mulgore's great trees, where tauren gather it from the grass. To the tauren, these nuts carry the land's spiritual vitality and latent magic. Tauren mystics have understood and used that power for generations. Young hunters and wanderers learn to watch the ground beneath the canopy and honor the Earth Mother's gifts.

In Bloodhoof Village, seer Zarlman Two-Moons prepares young tauren for the Rite of Vision with ambercorn. He combines it with stones gathered from the plains' water wells to make the Water of the Seers. Initiates drink the ceremonial brew before the ancestral flames. Their senses shift, revealing a guiding spirit animal meant to lead them to their next destination.
